title: gate
description: The gate job of the proof run workflow hears Proof run attested: it needs the attest job, so on a pull request it runs once the attestation is kept, also when the suites or the attest job fail, and not when the run is cancelled. It checks out the pull request's base commit into a folder of its own, builds assure there from the base's cmd/assure and internal/assure, with workspace mode off and with no cache restored, makes Lathe and the built binary read-only, and runs that binary in the change's checkout with the Lathe the workflow builds from LATHE_REF: assure gate change for the pull request's head against its base, which measures the base before the change, and reads the attestation from GitHub's store and verifies it. No code of the change's tree runs: Lathe reads its spec, whose product checks are queries that Lathe runs. When the gate cannot run, such as when Lathe or assure does not build, the job fails with a line that says the gate did not run.

title: qualify-release
description: The qualify-release job hears Compiler release published through the release output of the publish-release job, which it needs, in the same run. With contents: read only, it checks out the commit, fails at once when no checks run exists at the commit, waits within a bound for the checks run to complete, and runs scripts/qualify-compiler-release.py --verify-release for COMMIT when the output names the commit's release; the script verifies the passed release decision and installs the release through the consumer path.

title: publish-release
description: The publish-release job hears Release decided: it needs the gate-release and attest-release jobs of the same run and runs only when the gate-release output passed is true, so only on a push to main whose release passed, after the decision is attested; a refused decision skips it. It sends Publish a compiler release by its own steps, starting from the attested decision, which it verifies again.
